card.name: Words right before agonist or antagonist
card.fires_on: The word just before "agonist" or "antagonist" in drug-class lists, such as "receptor", "or" and "and" after "partial agonists". It is strongest in serotonin-drug interaction lists.

modes.label: Receptor before antagonist
modes.description: The word "receptor" or its ending "ceptor" sits right before "antagonist" or "agonist" in a drug class name.
modes.example: pinephrine reuptake inhibitors (SNRIs), tricyclic antidepressants (TCAs), triptans, 5-HT3<< receptor>> antagonists, drugs that affect the serotonin

modes.label: Linking word in agonist lists
